description: Se crea este grupo con el interés de resolver un reto astronómico para contar una historia del universo.
summary:
Our project aims to share the history of the space equipment and artifacts that NASA has left on the Moon, Mars, and other places in the Solar System. Through an interactive digital experience, we present information about these explorers, their missions, their functions, and the scientific discoveries they made possible.

We addressed the challenge by transforming historical and scientific information into visual, educational, and easy-to-understand content, especially for children, teenagers, and space enthusiasts.

This project is important because it helps people understand the technological and scientific advances that made great space missions possible. It also brings attention to machines that are often forgotten when their missions end, showing that their contributions remain valuable to humanity.

Our purpose is to spark curiosity and inspire new generations to become interested in science, technology, and space exploration.
details:
Our tool helps identify objects left behind on the Moon and Mars.

One of the main benefits of our tool is that it allows users to visualize the actual locations of objects left behind during space exploration missions on the Moon and Mars.

Our goal is to reach students, children, and young people who want to learn about and explore real information related to objects left behind on the Moon and Mars.

We developed this project using HTML, Python, CSS, JavaScript, and GitHub to create the website, as well as SVG for 2D modeling.

Our project is creative, innovative, and fun. It is easy to access, understand, and use, and it was developed using real data from NASA.

When designing our solution, we focused on meeting the challenge requirements while making astronomy an interesting and important science for children and young people who use our tool.
